'''Myrsk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who worked for the [[Security Police/Legends|Espos]] at [[Mondder Spaceport]] on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. He was a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], where he served with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He fled to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] at the end of the conflict to escape the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Speciesism|xenophobia]] and possible retaliation for his service.<ref name="AotE:IE2">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 2|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 2]]</ref>

==Biography==
[[File:MyrskAtWork-AOTE1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Myrsk at work, giving orders]]
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], he and his officers broke up a brawl that [[Jahan Cross]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were fighting with a group of disgruntled [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] patrons. When he attempted to arrest Cross, he claimed diplomatic immunity. When Myrsk attempted to arrest Solo and Chewbacca, Cross claimed they were in his employ and therefore also under diplomatic immunity. Myrsk then sarcastically asked if he could arrest the group of brawlers from the cantina. Once assured they were indeed criminals, he stalked away, muttering under his breath about how Imperials annoyed him.<ref name="Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref>

Myrsk was present at the [[Stark Compound]] when [[Jahan Cross]] was arrested for the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Dah'lis Stark]]. He informed Cross that his diplomatic immunity was revoked by [[Emesh Nar]]. After Cross overpowered a pair of [[Security Police/Legends|Espos]] and escaped, he attempted to shoot him down, but was stopped by [[Elli Stark]].<ref name="AotE:IE2" />

He investigated the crash of Cross's speeder after the agent escaped from the Stark Compound. He didn't believe that Cross died in the crash and decided to interrogate Solo to see if he knew of the whereabouts of Cross. He and [[Dimity]] interrogated Solo and Chewbacca aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], and when Solo sarcastically responded to his questions, he punched the smuggler. Chewbacca reacted violently and had to be restrained by Solo. Solo suggested that it would be wise for Myrsk to apologize, which the Espo did. He and Dimity departed the freighter, and Myrsk asked Dimity why he didn't back him up. Dimity responded that "it was above my pay grade."

Myrsk staked out the [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] where the ''Falcon'' was, confident that Cross would eventually show up. During this time, he was informed by [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] that [[Emesh Nar]] had been killed and the ambassador's private [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] had been stolen from the [[Imperial Embassy (Etti IV)|embassy]]. Myrsk ordered all units to intercept the stolen shuttle and prevent it from reaching orbit. When Cross, who was piloting the shuttle, attempted to bluff his way past the two [[K-222 Aero-Interceptor|interceptors]] sent after him by stating that the ambassador was on board, the sergeant interrupted and commanded the pilots to bring the shuttle to ground. As the pursuit returned to the surface of Etti IV, Myrsk followed in a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle. He ordered ground units to be at all intersections along the pursuit route and authorized them to shoot to kill if necessary. After he ran his ship into a mag-lev train, causing a huge accident, Myrsk arrived to survey the damage. Despite his partner's belief that Cross was immolated in the crash, Myrsk was confident he was still alive.<ref name="AotE3">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 3|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 3]]</ref>
